title: The No-Ring rule governs container elevation only
context: The rule was written as a ban on all rings, yet buttons and item media already used rings for edges, and state rings had no sanctioned place.
decision: The No-Ring rule applies to container elevation: a container does not show depth with a decorative ring or border. The ring-instead-of-border technique for edge definition on controls and small media is a formal part of the system and no longer marked experimental. A semantically coloured ring may express component state, such as selected or invalid.

alternatives.reason: Contradicts the shipped button and item edges.
Reviewers cannot tell a decorative ring from a state ring.

consequences: DESIGN.md states the rule in this narrower form when the docs migrate.
Focus rings stay on --ring, reserved for focus-visible.
